articles.title: EU entity suspected of losing $106 million from crypto exchange accounts, ZachXBT says
articles.snippet: The unidentified attacker moved funds through ether, instant exchanges and Monero, but the victim and affected exchanges remain unknown.

articles.title: North Korea denies role in $6.3B Binance hack, points finger at US
articles.snippet: Pyongyang has pushed back against the FBI’s attribution of the Binance attack, with Kim Yo Jong calling the US allegations politically motivated.

articles.title: Trezor lifts password ceiling after Coldcard’s $100M wallet thefts
articles.snippet: Trezor cited July’s Coldcard attacks, in which strong passphrases helped protect some users whose wallet recovery information was compromised.

articles.title: BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet thefts running on outdated software
articles.snippet: BTCPay Server urged operators to shut down their servers after receiving reports of unauthorized attackers draining funds from hot wallets.

articles.title: Claude-Built Linux Exploit Targets Bug That Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched
articles.snippet: Anthropic says Claude wrote an attack that can take over a Linux server with no password. Red Hat patched on Sunday, but Ubuntu still has no fix.
